requirements: Is there exactly one grid of 4 columns by 4 rows showing 16 separate items?
Does each item occupy its own cell without overlapping any other item or crossing cell boundaries?
Is each of the 16 items centered in its cell and filling about 70 percent of that cell?
Is there at least 12 percent empty margin on every side of each item within its cell?
Are the 16 items presented in left-to-right top-to-bottom order matching the exact list order provided?
Is the first item a striped popcorn bucket overflowing with buttery popcorn?
Is the second item a pale yellow bar of skate wax with visible grooves worn in it?
Is the third item a tiny clay taco with speckled glaze?
Is the fourth item a basket of lemons that includes a couple of leaves?
Is the fifth item a thick stack of screenplay pages with a brass brad?
